summary.headline: Fixed-Star Table and Spica
summary.text: Introduction to a table of fixed stars, giving their longitude, motion, temperament, latitude, and astrological effects according to Ptolemy. The discussion treats Spica, Lyra, Piscis Austrinus, Cygnus, Corona Borealis, and further stars, including their effects when aspected by Saturn or Jupiter in nativities.
